# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(SummarizedExperiment)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
ad_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR")
stat_dir <- file.path(
  ad_dir,
  "analysis-results",
  "only_amyloid_positive_2_stage_approach"
)
save_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "analysis-results")
cohort_path <- file.path(save_dir, "ADNI", "ADNI_2025_MCI_future_data.rds")
code_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "code", "R")

source(file.path(code_dir, "mrs_weights.R"))
source(file.path(code_dir, "mrs_scoring.R"))
```

# Load Data

```{r load}
# Run 07a_gather_ADNI_data.Rmd first to lock the 2025 MCI sample set.
adni_data <- readRDS(cohort_path)
beta_data <- adni_data$beta_data
pheno_df <- adni_data$pheno_df
```

# Analyze

```{r run, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6}
run_mrs_analysis(
  beta_data,
  out_dir = file.path(save_dir, "ADNI"),
  nonfinite_message =
    "New MRS weights produced non-finite scores for selected 2025 samples."
)
```

# Save to Phenotype

```{r save}
mrs_df <- read.csv(file.path(save_dir, "ADNI", "EAP_MRS_scores.csv"))
pheno_df <- pheno_df %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    mrs_df,
    by = c("sample" = "sample_id"),
    relationship = "one-to-one",
    na_matches = "never"
  )

write.csv(
  pheno_df,
  file = file.path(save_dir, "ADNI", "pheno_data.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
